description: This file defines types and interfaces related to channel setup wizards, including configuration options, status, hooks, and policies for channel onboarding in a plugin-based system.
external_methods: setPolicy: (cfg: OpenClawConfig, policy: DmPolicy, accountId?: string) => OpenClawConfig
promptAllowFrom: (params: { cfg: OpenClawConfig; prompter: WizardPrompter; accountId?: string }) => Promise<OpenClawConfig>

classes.name: ChannelSetupPlugin
classes.description: Type representing a subset of ChannelPlugin properties for setup purposes.

classes.name: SetupChannelsOptions
classes.description: Configuration options for setting up channels, including flags and callbacks.

classes.name: PromptAccountIdParams
classes.description: Parameters for prompting the user to select or input an account ID.

classes.name: ChannelSetupStatus
classes.description: Status information for a channel's setup process.

classes.name: ChannelSetupStatusContext
classes.description: Context for retrieving the status of channel setup.

classes.name: ChannelSetupConfigureContext
classes.description: Context for configuring a channel during setup.

classes.name: ChannelOnboardingPostWriteContext
classes.description: Context after writing onboarding configuration to a channel.

classes.name: ChannelOnboardingPostWriteHook
classes.description: Hook executed after onboarding configuration is written.

classes.name: ChannelSetupResult
classes.description: Result of a channel setup operation.

classes.name: ChannelSetupConfiguredResult
classes.description: Result indicating a configured channel or a skip signal.

classes.name: ChannelSetupInteractiveContext
classes.description: Context for interactive channel setup, extending configuration context.

classes.name: ChannelSetupDmPolicy
classes.description: Policy related to direct messaging permissions for a channel.

classes.name: ChannelSetupWizardAdapter
classes.description: Interface for channel setup wizard operations including status, configuration, and hooks.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Fetches the current setup status of a channel.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Configures a channel based on provided context.

methods.name: configureInteractive
methods.description: Interactively configures a channel, if supported.

methods.name: configureWhenConfigured
methods.description: Configures a channel when it is already marked as configured.

methods.name: afterConfigWritten
methods.description: Hook called after configuration is written to a channel.

methods.name: onAccountRecorded
methods.description: Callback when an account is recorded for a channel.
